The <b>Whispering Vaults</b>, shortened to <b>Vaults</b>, is an [[Areas (Silksong)|area]] in [[the Citadel]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. {{MissingInfo}}

== Description ==
The Whispering Vaults serves as a library of sorts for the Citadel. [[Psalm Cylinder]]s can be found and played in the Whispering Vaults. To play one, speak to [[Vaultkeeper Cardinius]]. Giving them the [[Sacred Cylinder]] unlocks the [[Vaultkeeper's Melody]].

== History ==
Before the Haunting, the Vaults contained most of the Citadel's history, prayers, and secrets. The [[Keepers]] were tasked with maintaining and defending the Vaults.<ref>[[Cogwork Statues]]: <i>"We would hear the voice of the Keepers, within their grand vaults. They who guard our history, our prayers and our secrets, across the ages."</i></ref> The Vaults contained all sorts of information, from old methods of prayer to information about [[Pharloom]], its rulers, and the strength at its heart.<ref>Vaultkeeper Cardinius: <i>"Within our vast store, always more there is to know, the old methods of prayer, to this land, to its rulers, and to the strength at its heart."</i></ref> The Vaults were considered a holy place deserving of reverence, and the Keepers did not take kindly to people wandering idly between the shelves.<ref>Vaultkeeper Cardinius: <i>"One must not wander idle between these sacred shelves! This is a holy place. Reverence! It is demanded."</i></ref> 

At some point, the pontiff learnt through the [[Sacred Cylinder]] the true purpose of the Citadel and its songs. This knowledge caused them to fall silent.<ref>Vaultkeeper Cardinius: <i>"A truth they were told to have found... There in the dark. Something within the melody, or the words. Something to set them silent..."</i></ref>

== How to Access ==
The Whispering Vaults can be found on the eastern side of the Citadel, accessed initially from the south-east side of the [[Cogwork Core]]. 

A passage can be opened between the Whispering Vaults and [[Songclave]], and a lift to the [[Underworks]] is unlocked after defeating [[Trobbio]].

<b>The Stage</b> is located in the south-west of the Whispering Vaults, connecting the [[Choral Chambers]] and the Whispering Vaults. 

Trobbio's desk and writings can be found in the room above the Stage itself.

A large poster of Trobbio and a sign can be found in the entranceway to the Stage during [[Act 2]], which is replaced with a poster of [[Tormented Trobbio]] during [[Act 3]]. Both times, upon defeating him and {{MissingInfo}}, the current poster gets removed.
